verdict.rationale: Unleash documents strategy variants for exposing different feature versions "as part of A/B and multivariate testing," and its marketing mentions experimenting, so the experiment-setup half of the story is covered. However, the documented impact metrics are rollout safeguards (error-rate and latency thresholds that pause or advance milestones), not analysis of which variant wins on business metrics. Missing for 10: built-in experiment results or winner analysis per variant, statistical significance reporting, binding of product/conversion metrics to variants, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
